summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated 14 September 2026 titled 'Drilling Results Support Potential Resource Growth.' The release reports positive tungsten assay results from the newly discovered Tremor Zone and previously untested Good Hope Zone at its 100%-owned Pilot Mountain tungsten project in Nevada. Highlighted intersections include 64.15m @ 0.20% WO3 at Tremor and 12.95m @ 0.79% WO3 at Good Hope; results prompted relocation of the planned tailings storage facility. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed.
